Variants.Content: Qamayl is the Iban island and its shipping routes located on the Shivering Sea, and is politically within the Iban island and port system. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.
Entry Kamyre Local families also relied on blubber, fish, furs, hardwoods and the short shipping season; if a road, well or dock failed, the price fell first to them.

Entry Kamyre They will also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of Iban and the Shivering Sea; reputations can spread far from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.

Entry Kamyre If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

From workshops to sanctuaries, Kama'il juxtaposes shipbuilding wood, canvas, salt, fish catch, and wind-proof stones with Iban ancestral spirits, sea monster legends, and shared taboos of frigid ports. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Kamyre They care about blubber, fish catches, furs, hardwoods, and the short sailing season. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting food and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
